title: Beat editor: drum machine step sequencer
description: Pads x steps grid round-tripping .apr via rw_beat_read/rw_beat_write in wasm; swing/tempo; loop transport.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Design (approved 2026-09-25): text stays the source of truth. rw_steps wasm export (dsl::parse + parse_steps) gives kits/pads/tracks with lines; web/src/ui/beat/model.ts reads a grid and rewrites the kit's track lines as one canonical 'track kit.pad steps' line per pad (x, [x x] ratchets, x _ holds, | per bar); BeatView panel (Steps|Flow toggle, default Steps for beats): pad column with audition + live mute/solo (not saved), step grid with paint/ratchet/hold, playhead, tempo/swing/length strip. Read-only when grid!=16, nested/uneven brackets, or track effects/at/bars/etc.
